description: Check whether a website's tracking is installed and receiving page views, with blocked-request issues, their fix, and the latest coding-agent install report. Use when data looks missing or after installing.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: check_tracking

outputSchema.description: hasEvents is whether any page view ever arrived; recentPageViews counts the last 24 hours. trackingIssue is the main blocked-request problem with its fix; its origins and hosts come from the blocked requests, so confirm them with the user before adding one to Allowed Origins. localInstall is a local host the script ran on. agentInstall is a coding agent's last self-reported install, read only when nothing arrived: its known completed steps and unresolved issue types (other for unknown ones).

title: Check tracking
